title: Green Bean and Potato Salad
description: This green bean potato salad with red onion and basil is tossed in a zippy Dijon mustard and balsamic vinaigrette for a tasty side dish or easy lunch.
ingredients: 0.75 pound fresh green beans, trimmed and snapped

steps.text: Place potatoes in a large pot and fill with about 1 inch of water; bring to a boil. Cook until potatoes are tender, about 15 minutes; add green beans to steam after the first 10 minutes. Drain and allow to cool slightly.
Cut potatoes into quarters and transfer to a large bowl. Add green beans, onion, basil, salt, and pepper; toss until combined. Set aside.
Whisk together olive oil, balsamic vinegar, mustard, lemon juice, garlic, and Worcestershire sauce in a medium bowl until well combined. Pour over salad and stir to coat. Season with salt and pepper.

video.description: A great side for that summer party that’s flavorful and will have you coming back for seconds. The mustard, lemon juice, and Worcestershire sauce blend exquisitely together. The softness of the potatoes and the fresh snap of the steamed green beans pair well for a wonderful side dish.
